g.text: The 52 most-connected firms of the graph at three or more shared directors — the threshold past which the network is no longer held up by single-name edges (figure 21). Node area is weighted degree and colour is

territory; an edge joining two different territories is drawn darker and heavier — 126 of the 179 drawn. That distinction is a step along the grey ramp rather than a hue: the hues are already spent on territory, and
one colour cannot mean two things in one figure. Names that would not fit are in the table.
